epics.title: Foundation: repository, contracts and development workflow
epics.outcome: A locked Python monorepo with agreed runtime/evaluation contracts, isolated development services and honest offline CI.
epics.gate: Fresh checkout installs successfully; one fake case traverses agent → gateway → scorer → report; labels stay outside agent input; CI does not claim unimplemented evaluation passed.

epics.title: Shared harness: gateway, evaluation and observability
epics.outcome: A real provider-backed gateway plus strict replay, state-based evaluation, fault injection, tracing and candidate release evidence.
epics.gate: Request mismatches fail offline; fresh trials bypass response reuse; missing cases fail completeness; recovery, review and unsafe outcomes are distinct; reports carry reproducible manifests.

epics.title: Olist: complete source-grounded support workflow
epics.outcome: A usable e-commerce application with authentic order context, policy-enforced refunds, durable review, restart recovery and independently verified results.
epics.gate: Valid refund once; excessive/unauthorized action blocked; correct review with evidence; timeout after commit and restart cannot duplicate effects; real-source provenance and fresh held-out results.

epics.title: CFPB: complaint classification and calibrated routing
epics.outcome: A second framework and classification vertical on published complaints, with calibrated routing and risk review.
epics.gate: No target-category leakage; temporal/grouped holdout; macro-F1 and high-risk recall at declared review load; routing compared with rules and always-strong baselines.

epics.title: Revenue integrity: authentic extraction and controlled reconciliation
epics.outcome: Real-contract extraction plus a separately reported billing simulation with deterministic calculations, approval-bound changes and conflict-safe compensation.
epics.gate: Real extraction and synthetic reconciliation results separated; independent gold-terms tests; benign exceptions handled; unauthorized changes blocked; ledger totals and safe compensation verified.

epics.title: Prior auth: cited criterion assessment and review
epics.outcome: An educational evidence-assessment application for selected policies, with verified criteria, isolated labels and durable document waits.
epics.gate: No denial or real authorization tool; incorrect approval recommendation measured; supported evidence checked; missing information handled; illustrative and counterfactual inputs reported separately.

epics.title: Supply chain: disruption assessment and budgeted actions
epics.outcome: A source-grounded logistics simulation with bounded interventions, budget allocation, approval waits and resilient execution.
epics.gate: No unapproved/over-cap spend or duplicate effect; costs compared with do-nothing/rules/solver baselines on separate held-out simulator scenarios; aviation proxy claims clearly separated.

epics.title: Release engineering and cross-vertical operations
epics.outcome: A repeatable deployment and release process with health checks, operating guides, evidence reports and tracked limitations.
epics.gate: Critical invariants and required cases pass; candidate evidence complete; migrations/restore/rollback verified; each completed vertical has an honest model card and runbook.

tasks.title: Create locked Python monorepo and package boundaries
tasks.scope: Create pyproject/lockfile, harness and vertical package skeletons, tests layout, environment example and ignore rules. No raw data or credentials enter Git.
checks: A clean environment can install the locked dependencies and import the shared package.
Harness never imports a vertical and verticals never import each other; a deliberately bad import fails the boundary check.
README distinguishes working commands from planned commands.

tasks.title: Define runtime, model, case and score contracts with fake implementations
tasks.scope: Define RunContext, agent input/result, complete model request/response, EvalCase, ScoreResult and FaultScenario. Keep expected labels in evaluator-only objects.
checks: One fake case runs end to end without a network or database service.
Agent-visible input cannot contain expected labels or hidden simulator state.
Outcome, review reference, evidence, usage and typed failures survive serialization.

tasks.title: Provide matching Windows and CI command entrypoints
tasks.scope: Choose one portable Python command interface; Make may wrap it on Linux. Document setup, lint/types/imports/test and planned eval modes.
checks: Documented Windows PowerShell commands and CI use the same underlying checks.
A command referencing an unimplemented feature fails clearly rather than succeeding silently.
One fresh-checkout setup walkthrough is reproducible.

tasks.title: Isolate Postgres state and services per worktree and trial
tasks.scope: Define Postgres migrations, test reset/fixtures and per-worktree service identifiers, ports and volumes. Record checkpoint, review and ledger ownership.
checks: Two development workspaces can run without sharing writable state.
Each trial starts from a known snapshot and cannot see another trial's writes.
Migration up/down or restore instructions are verified against a disposable database.

tasks.title: Add offline CI and repository contribution checks
tasks.scope: CI runs lint, types, imports and meaningful tests; later replay is added when fixtures exist. Include dependency/secret checks and PR-linked issue conventions.
checks: A deliberately failing contract test or forbidden import fails CI.
CI has no provider-network dependency and does not silently skip required evaluation.
Contributors can identify the issue, acceptance evidence and shared-contract owner for a PR.

tasks.title: Select and pin the first provider/framework/trace integration
tasks.scope: Inspect current primary documentation and local constraints; document primary model identity, SDK pins, structured output/tool support, LangGraph/Pydantic AI interoperability and one tracing backend.
checks: An ADR records the tested integration and why alternatives are deferred.
A smoke request verifies structured output/tool behavior on the selected provider without committing secrets.
Provider limits and timestamp are recorded; model aliases and their drift limits are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement provider adapter and canonical model request matching
tasks.scope: Build actual model transport with typed responses, usage and errors. Match complete ordered messages, provider/model, params, tool/output schemas and serializer version.
checks: Valid, malformed and transport-error responses are handled through the contract.
Prompt content and schema changes produce distinct request identities.
Trial/call occurrence preserves different responses to identical requests.

tasks.title: Implement immutable recordings and strict network-free replay
tasks.scope: Persist sanitized request/response/error sequences and provenance in SQLite or an exportable fixture format. Strict replay executes current code and fails on mismatch.
checks: Replay can run with provider credentials absent and outbound calls blocked.
Missing or changed request fails with case/trial/call evidence; no live fallback.
Repeated call order and typed recorded failures are reproduced; fixtures are not overwritten.

tasks.title: Enforce deadlines, retries, circuit state and reserved budgets
tasks.scope: Bound calls, tokens, retries and elapsed time; reserve budget before dispatch and account for failed attempts. Inject transport through an interface.
checks: 429/5xx/timeout tests terminate within configured limits.
Concurrent calls cannot exceed the shared run budget by checking it at the same time.
Exhaustion yields typed safe-stop/review outcome and usage; retry loops are bounded.
tasks.completion_evidence: Clean main: 276 tests, 19 typed files, imports/Ruff/lock, six-call strict replay with two timeouts and zero provider calls. Main run 38803477072: nine applicable jobs passed; native Done verified.

tasks.title: Implement versioned case manifests and independent scorer registration
tasks.scope: Load cases and domain scorer plugins with snapshot references, source category, eligibility, grouped split IDs and fixed evaluator versions.
checks: Duplicate/missing case IDs and incompatible snapshots fail validation.
Labels, eligibility and hidden outcome data stay out of agent-visible views.
A known correct/incorrect mock result is scored independently from the agent's own claimed success.
tasks.completion_evidence: Separate clean main: 329 tests, 21 typed files, imports/Ruff/lock; exact six-call replay/two timeouts/zero provider calls. Main run 38815711769: nine applicable jobs passed. Native Done verified.

tasks.title: Run isolated trials with complete outcome accounting
tasks.scope: Execute cases with reset state, clock/seed and bounded concurrency. Record completion, appropriate review, safe unresolved and unsafe outcomes plus scorer failures.
checks: Every scheduled case/trial has a terminal accounting row, including timeouts and exceptions.
An escalate-everything agent earns no autonomous-completion credit on eligible cases.
Missing results/scorer errors mark evidence incomplete and cannot pass a release gate.
tasks.review_evidence: 380 offline tests, 25 typed source files, imports/Ruff/format/lock; six package builds; fresh installed base wheel gives completion 2/2 and escalation 0/2 with network audit denial. Final hosted and database evidence recorded on issue #20. Native Review move pending because browser controls are unavailable.
tasks.completion_evidence: Clean merged main: 380 tests, 25 typed files, imports/Ruff/format/lock; six-call replay/two timeouts/zero provider calls. Push-main run 38959680261 passed nine applicable jobs. Native Done read-back unavailable after UI recovery failure.

tasks.title: Add seeded failure scenarios and state invariants
tasks.scope: Inject bad model output, outage, stale reads, tool timeout before/after commit, duplicates and injection content. Declare recoverability before execution.
checks: Scenario seed/timing can be reproduced without production writes.
Recovery and appropriate handoff are scored separately; unresolved outage is not automatic recovery.
Invariant checks inspect state/ledger and identify duplicate or unauthorized effects.
tasks.review_evidence: 425 offline tests (45 H7), 29 typed source files, imports/Ruff/format/lock, 16 Postgres cases, six builds and rebuilt installed base-wheel seven recovery/one review checks. Final exact-head CI/replay recorded on #21. Native board read-back unavailable after UI helper recovery failed.
tasks.completion_evidence: Main CI run 38965744185: nine applicable jobs passed. Clean local 424 passes, one pre-start Windows timeout; unchanged case passed in isolation. Exact replay six calls/two timeouts/zero provider calls. Native board unverified.

tasks.title: Export correlated traces with redaction and health diagnostics
tasks.scope: Instrument run/model/node/tool/policy spans with versions and source evidence; export to one chosen backend. Handle exporter failure without hiding runtime outcomes.
checks: A run can be followed from model request through tool result and scorer.
Identifier/secret canaries do not appear in exported traces or reports.
Exporter flush/cleanup is verified and observability failure is visible.
tasks.review_evidence: 472 offline tests, 33 typed source files, imports/Ruff/format/lock, six builds, rebuilt base/telemetry-extra installed isolation and actual local seven-observation CLI read-back. Strict replay retains v1 and proposes v2/pin for the new lock. Final-head CI, clean trace/replay and required Postgres results are recorded on #22. Native board unverified.

tasks.title: Generate honest scorecards and case-level baseline comparisons
tasks.scope: Produce JSON/Markdown reports with completion, review burden, violations, fault outcomes, usage, split/source slices and uncertainty.
checks: Numerators/denominators and fresh/replay modes are explicit; missing outcomes are included.
Paired baseline comparison surfaces newly failing required cases even when averages improve.
Zero-event safety reports use 0/N and a suitable rare-event interval; no zero-width bootstrap safety claim.

tasks.title: Implement cache-bypassed candidate recording and release evidence gates
tasks.scope: Implement eval-record, eval-compare and eval-release semantics with immutable candidate manifests and a separately reviewed baseline.
checks: Three fresh trials cannot reuse earlier candidate responses.
Behavior fingerprints tie evidence to the candidate; model-visible changes require fresh affected-slice evidence.
Missing/expired/incompatible evidence or critical violations block release; candidate cannot automatically bless its own baseline.

tasks.title: Add second provider fallback and separately evaluated routing
tasks.scope: After the first complete release, add one fallback provider and provider-specific circuit breakers. Evaluate fallback quality instead of assuming equivalence.
checks: Controlled provider outage routes or safely stops with traceable provider choice.
Fallback quality/cost and cross-provider schema support are reported separately.
Fallback never bypasses replay matching, run limits or policy enforcement.

tasks.title: Acquire Olist snapshot and validate source provenance/use conditions
tasks.scope: Obtain original Olist source via documented access; record checksum, version, dates, language, currency, attribution/use conditions and required files.
checks: Manifest and repeatable local acquisition instructions exist; raw files are excluded from Git.
Source publisher/version and missing fields are recorded rather than inferred.
The permitted handling/export path and credential-free CI fixture strategy are explicit.

tasks.title: Build orders_360 with correct joins and historical as-of views
tasks.scope: Import/aggregate orders, items, payments, delivery and reviews at declared grain; produce scoped snapshots that expose only facts known at case time.
checks: Key/cardinality/totals checks detect duplicate join inflation.
Future delivery/review facts cannot leak into an earlier request view.
Currency, missingness, provenance and Portuguese/translation handling are preserved.

tasks.title: Write refund/reship rules and independently reviewed case sets
tasks.scope: Version policy, eligibility/review rules and source-grounded support messages. Create development/regression/holdout splits grouped by order.
checks: Expected actions come from reviewed policy examples independent of runtime implementation.
Original records, hybrid messages and adversarial edits have separate source labels.
Case evidence includes valid refund, over-limit, missing-data and genuinely ambiguous outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement scoped order tools and transactional refund ledger
tasks.scope: Build typed reads/writes on the controlled business backend; enforce scopes, per-order/run limits and stable tenant/business-operation idempotency.
checks: Authorized refund changes state once; duplicate event in a new run returns the original result.
Over-limit, unauthorized and payload-mismatched repeated-key requests cannot write.
State transition and audit/ledger are consistent after transaction failure or timeout-after-commit.

tasks.title: Build the LangGraph workflow with bounded reasoning and validation
tasks.scope: Implement intent/context/policy/proposed-action/tool/result flow, checkpointing and step limits. Responses reflect actual committed state.
checks: Refund/status/review paths execute against source-grounded context.
Model/tool input injection cannot relax code-enforced write rules.
Claiming a successful refund without committed state fails output verification.

tasks.title: Implement durable review and exact-action approval/resume
tasks.scope: Persist review evidence and reviewer decisions. Bind approval to action payload, tenant/actor and record version; resume without restarting side effects.
checks: Human can inspect evidence, approve/reject and see the audited decision.
Stale approval or changed record requires re-evaluation rather than writing.
Restart preserves review state; repeated approval/resume cannot refund twice.

tasks.title: Provide authenticated API and usable support/review interface
tasks.scope: Expose request/status/review routes, tenant/role checks and a usable operator interface. Include error/loading/empty states and health diagnostics.
checks: Complete request-to-review-to-outcome flow works through the application.
A different tenant/role cannot read a case, approve or invoke writes.
UI accurately shows pending, failed and committed actions and evidence.

tasks.title: Verify crash recovery and publish the first complete release evidence
tasks.scope: Run state-based Olist scorers, commit-timeout/crash/restart scenarios, fresh held-out evaluation and a three-trial reliability subset; publish model card/runbook.
checks: State checks show no duplicate/over-limit/unauthorized effects across fault tests.
Report separates source-grounded and synthetic/adversarial cases, review burden and incomplete results.
Release artifact contains source/split/code/scorer manifests and a reproducible operational walkthrough.

tasks.title: Import CFPB complaints and build a label-isolated temporal split
tasks.scope: Snapshot published narratives/metadata with source taxonomy versions. Store consumer-selected product/issue labels only in evaluation tables.
checks: Agent input excludes targets and other answer-revealing metadata.
Temporal/grouped holdout and category changes are documented.
Manifest records missing narratives, masking patterns and consumer-label limitations.

tasks.title: Review risk/ambiguity labels and establish deterministic baselines
tasks.scope: Write labeling rules, blind-label risk/ambiguous examples in batches and implement majority/rules baselines.
checks: Labels include reviewer/guideline/version evidence and disagreements.
Risk labels are not derived from candidate predictions.
Baseline results and slice denominators are published before tuning.

tasks.title: Implement Pydantic AI classifier and calibrated routing
tasks.scope: Return typed product/issue/priority and evidence; calibrate routing/abstention on a development-only set and compare cheap-first with always-strong.
checks: Invalid taxonomy or budget failure routes safely with audit evidence.
Coverage/error and high-risk recall are reported at a declared review fraction.
Router thresholds never fit the final holdout.

tasks.title: Integrate scoped review, API, traces and drift monitoring
tasks.scope: Expose classification/review workflow with enqueue-only tools; monitor input/output taxonomy mix, masked text and model/provider changes.
checks: Tenant boundaries and no-write scopes are enforced in tools.
Category/length/language shifts trigger documented diagnostic outputs.
API surfaces decision, uncertainty and review evidence accurately.

tasks.title: Evaluate routing tradeoffs and release the CFPB vertical
tasks.scope: Run held-out classification/risk results, provider/injection faults and repeated-trial subset; publish model card, runbook and resource comparison.
checks: Macro-F1, minority slices and risk recall/review-load tradeoff are explicit.
No label leakage or unsupported population/harm claim appears in the report.
Fresh evidence and required-case gates pass; observed failures remain documented.

tasks.title: Build original-contract extraction corpus and family-level holdout
tasks.scope: Acquire CUAD plus suitable EDGAR agreements if needed; preserve original context and reviewed field/span labels. Keep constructed clauses in separate sets.
checks: Manifest records provenance, permissions and real-field coverage gaps.
Contracts/templates do not cross development/holdout family boundaries.
Numeric/citation gold labels are reviewed independently from extractor output.

tasks.title: Generate billing worlds with leakage and benign exceptions
tasks.scope: Seed accounts/subscriptions/invoices and construct seat/price/uplift/ramp/amendment cases. Maven, if used, is labeled a fictional hardware CRM fixture.
checks: Injected labels match independently hand-checked money/date examples.
Benign ramps/credits/amendments are first-class negative cases.
Hidden should-be schedules and leakage labels cannot be read by the agent.

tasks.title: Extract reusable access mechanisms from two demonstrated consumers
tasks.scope: Compare Olist and Revenue tool/catalog needs; move only common scope/registry/write mechanism into harness/access with migration contracts.
checks: Shared code names no domain-specific refund/invoice rules.
Olist still passes its contracts after migration and Revenue has its own rules.
In-process tools remain testable; MCP adapter exposes the same contracts when added.

tasks.title: Implement cited term extraction and independent reconciliation engine
tasks.scope: Build extractor/verifier and exact money/date/amendment reconciliation. Evaluate gold-terms and extracted-terms paths independently.
checks: Gold-terms tests catch logic bugs without invoking a model.
A citation's existence alone does not validate the commercial meaning.
Original extraction and hybrid end-to-end errors are separated in reports.

tasks.title: Implement approval-bound changes, ledger and conflict-safe compensation
tasks.scope: Allow limited CRM hygiene, require approval for billing/merges, bind exact payload/version, enforce stable operation keys and compensating rollback.
checks: Stale/reused approval and unauthorized writes are blocked.
Retry, duplicate webhook and partial batch failure cannot create duplicate effects.
Compensation appends a ledger entry and refuses to overwrite an intervening legitimate change.

tasks.title: Deliver approval UI, digest and event-driven orchestration
tasks.scope: Build usable findings/review interface and ledger-reconciled digest; add thin Inngest event/sweep/approval wrappers after confirming current SDK support.
checks: Found/proposed/approved/applied/rejected simulated dollars are distinct and reconcile.
One owner per wait/checkpoint; wrapper retry is idempotent.
API/UI handles review rejection, stale data and long waits visibly.

tasks.title: Publish real extraction and simulated reconciliation release results
tasks.scope: Evaluate precision, case/dollar-weighted recall, benign false alarms, unsafe effects, independent compensation and engine/catalog ablations.
checks: Real-source and synthetic results are separate; no real recovered revenue claim.
Per-category results and completed/incomplete cases are visible.
Release manifests, threat model, failure log, runbook and fresh evidence satisfy gates.

tasks.title: Select suitable policies and verify source/use and reviewer constraints
tasks.scope: Choose checkable coverage policies and transcription examples; record effective dates, code-content restrictions, illustrative status and domain review availability.
checks: Chosen scope and source references are documented; no blanket redistributability assumption.
Criteria wording is reviewed by a qualified reviewer if available, with limitations stated if not.
Diagnosis versus procedure-code validation requirements are explicit.

tasks.title: Build redacted spans and independent note-policy labels
tasks.scope: Segment illustrative notes with stable offsets; label met/not_met/insufficient and supporting spans, plus marked counterfactual pairs.
checks: Original samples and edits have separate provenance/splits.
Overall expected decisions are independently checked, not solely generated by the production aggregator.
Redaction/citation mapping and label isolation are verified.

tasks.title: Implement retrieval, criterion assessment and supporting-evidence checks
tasks.scope: Evaluate selected policy criteria with structured evidence; validate both span integrity and criterion support, code types and policy version.
checks: Unsupported/no-evidence met assessments become insufficient/review.
Conflicting/missing policy input cannot yield an automatic approval recommendation.
Retrieval and criterion-assessment errors can be diagnosed separately.

tasks.title: Implement recommendation-only policy flow and durable document waits
tasks.scope: Aggregate criteria, request information or route to qualified review; persist exact policy/version/document state and re-evaluate affected criteria.
checks: There is no deny_request or real authorization tool/API route.
Document arrivals/timeouts and restarts resume without duplicate queue effects.
Policy version change invalidates obsolete candidate decisions.

tasks.title: Build reviewer interface and protected evidence access
tasks.scope: Show criterion/evidence/rationale table, missing information, review events and policy provenance under tenant/role access.
checks: Only redacted views are model-visible; identifier canaries do not leak to traces.
Unauthorized reviewer cannot inspect/change another case.
Reviewer can identify uncertainty, conflicts and pending document waits.

tasks.title: Release criterion, recommendation-risk and abstention evidence
tasks.scope: Evaluate incorrect approval recommendations with both denominators, criterion support, appropriate routing and required-information behavior.
checks: Incorrect recommendations/all recommendations and /non-approvable cases are both reported.
Illustrative versus edited examples and clinical-label limitations remain explicit.
Fresh results, policy manifests, privacy/injection faults and runbook meet gates.

tasks.title: Import shipping records and capture versioned weather snapshots
tasks.scope: Prepare DataCo shipping observations and NWS alert snapshots with coverage/timezones. Keep BTS passenger-airline proxy optional and separately labeled.
checks: No unverified historical weather-shipment causal join is claimed.
Manifest records alert freshness, expiry and independent source lineage.
Agent-visible facts respect the scenario clock and available source coverage.

tasks.title: Build an independent holdout simulator and baseline policies
tasks.scope: Specify intervention outcomes/costs, held-out scenarios, do-nothing/rules/solver policies and sensitivity parameters.
checks: Hidden realized outcomes are not available to the agent.
Different seeds/template/scenario families and a holdout outcome model test simulator overfit.
Total realized simulated cost and absolute/normalized baseline differences are defined.

tasks.title: Implement options, portfolio allocation and transactional spend tools
tasks.scope: Generate bounded options; allocate budget and enforce per-action/run limits with stable event identity and fresh record checks.
checks: Concurrent executions cannot overspend or double execute.
Over-threshold actions require exact approval; stale budget state blocks commit.
Failure after commit returns the original effect on retry.

tasks.title: Implement assessment, approvals, confirmations and bounded replanning
tasks.scope: Build LangGraph assessment and thin Inngest event/fan-out/wait orchestration, with one state owner per concern.
checks: Approval/confirmation timeouts have explicit safe terminal outcomes.
Replanning terminates and preserves already committed effects.
Region bursts and duplicate/out-of-order events have deterministic tests.

tasks.title: Build operations interface and truthful shipment notifications
tasks.scope: Show affected shipments, proposals, budget, approvals, confirmations and failures; messages use verified shipment/alert facts.
checks: Operators can see pending/unresolved/committed actions distinctly.
Budget/approval access is tenant/role scoped.
Notifications cannot state unconfirmed execution or invented delivery outcomes.

tasks.title: Release held-out cost, budget and recovery evaluation
tasks.scope: Compare simulated realized cost with all baselines, fault recovery and scenario sensitivity; record proxy and causal limits.
checks: Completed, unresolved and unsafe outcomes are all counted.
No actual freight savings claim is made from the simulation.
Spend/duplicate invariants, fresh candidate evidence, model card and runbook meet gates.

tasks.title: Package deployment, health checks and operator configuration
tasks.scope: Ship an actual runnable API/operator application with validated environment, migrations, liveness/readiness and resource limits; document initial host choice.
checks: Fresh deployment serves a source-grounded Olist request and review flow.
Missing secret/database/schema produces actionable startup failure.
Shutdown flushes telemetry and preserves durable work.

tasks.title: Verify backup, restore and safe release rollback
tasks.scope: Define recovery objectives, state backup/restore, migration compatibility, pinned application/config rollback and ledger compensation distinctions.
checks: Restore recreates checkpoint/review/ledger state in an isolated environment.
Application rollback does not silently undo business actions or overwrite newer state.
A documented operator exercise verifies recovery, not merely a written checklist.

tasks.title: Calibrate optional judges and monitoring against reviewed cases
tasks.scope: After real error analysis, add narrow judge checks only for subjective outputs and monitor deployed traces; keep deterministic business checks primary.
checks: Calibration and held-out judge validation are distinct.
Judge failure cannot override a failed write/state invariant.
Observed failures enter new versioned cases with provenance and review.

tasks.title: Publish cross-vertical release evidence and finished-project documentation
tasks.scope: Prepare versioned reports/model cards/threat models/runbooks and practical demonstrations for all completed verticals.
checks: Each vertical has its own source limitations, denominators, baseline and known failures.
No blended cross-industry accuracy or invented business savings appear.
Complete release manifests and fresh behavior-change evidence support every shipped claim.

tasks.title: Enable native GitHub Project views, milestones and workflow automation
tasks.scope: Complete native board administration when a Project-capable connection is available: link repository, add existing issues, configure status/area/priority/size/iteration and archive rules.
checks: Existing issues are reused rather than duplicated.
Board has Backlog/Ready/In progress/Review/Done plus a blocker field; milestones match delivery epics.
Native creation/access is verified; this issue remains open if capability is unavailable.

completion_evidence.verification: Native saved configuration, all 53 task fields checked against manifest, 61 milestone assignments read from server, eight epic task counts verified.
